mapper.sql: SELECT l.*,m.name AS seller_name,sc.name AS seller_school_name FROM sale_listing l LEFT JOIN member m ON m.id=l.seller_member_id LEFT JOIN school sc ON sc.id=m.school_id
mapper.select: ORDER BY exposure_priority, CASE WHEN exposure_priority=0 THEN regtime END DESC, CASE WHEN exposure_priority=1 THEN bumped_at END DESC, CASE WHEN exposure_priority=2 THEN seller_temperature END DESC, regtime DESC, selno DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE sales SET category=#{category}, name=#{name}, oprice=#{oprice}, buyprice=#{buyprice}, wishprice=#{wishprice}, detail=#{detail}, location=#{location}, photo1=#{photo1}, photo2=#{photo2}, photo3=#{photo3} WHERE selno=#{selno}
UPDATE sales SET discount=#{rate}, starttime=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, endtime=DATEADD('HOUR',24,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WHERE selno=#{selno} AND status='판매중' AND (discount=0 OR endtime <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
UPDATE sales SET discount=0,starttime=NULL,endtime=NULL WHERE selno=#{selno} AND status='판매중'
UPDATE sales SET bumped_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE selno=#{selno} AND status='판매중' AND (bumped_at IS NULL OR bumped_at <= DATEADD('HOUR',-24,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
UPDATE sales SET status=#{status} WHERE selno=#{selno}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trade_orders WHERE selno=#{selno}
SELECT selno FROM sales WHERE selno=#{selno} FOR UPDATE
